name: Newco Welding

hero.title: We don't subcontract. We don't ship generic material.
hero.lead: Newco Welding fabricates, delivers and installs structural steel from Baytown for homeowners, builders and light industrial clients across Greater Houston.
hero.titleAccent: Structural steel is what we do.

highlights.title: Our own crew
highlights.text: We fabricate, deliver and install ourselves, with no subcontracting.

highlights.title: Local to Houston
highlights.text: We're a Houston-area company, not a national supplier routing jobs through a call center.

highlights.title: Homes to light industrial
highlights.text: We serve residential, commercial and light industrial clients.

steps.title: We review your plans
steps.text: You send your structural drawings or engineer's specifications, and we check dimensions, materials and connection details before anything is cut or welded.

steps.title: We fabricate in our shop
steps.text: All steel is cut to length, drilled, welded and inspected against your spec.

steps.title: We deliver to your site
steps.text: Material arrives on a coordinated schedule that we confirm with your GC or homeowner.

steps.title: We install the steel
steps.text: When installation is in scope, our crew sets the steel, makes the connections and welds in the field.

about.title: Built around fabricating steel the right way
text: Newco Welding was built around a straightforward idea: fabricate structural steel the right way, communicate clearly, and show up when you say you will.
Every component is cut to length, welded, drilled and inspected in our shop to your engineer's drawings before it reaches the job site.
We are not a national supplier or a general fab shop, and when something needs attention, you talk to the people doing the work.
